surface_value: positive results were presented from the Company's Phase 2 proof-of-concept (POC) clinical trial of enobosarm 3 mg administered orally in post-menopausal women with SUI. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) results showed a statistically significant increase in several important measurements and support the mechanism of action of enobosarm on the pelvic floor.
